# Kernel fixture provenance

## Coordinate layouts

`coordinate-layout.txt` is the stdout of a Lean program that instantiates the
maintained high-half-first semantics over BLS12-381::Fr.
It contains 20 cases at n=1..5, four seeds per arity, all 60 quadratic rounds,
Boolean sums, and both final MLE values. This is generated by Lean, not by the
Rust implementation under test.

Source SHA-256: `21ddd0c6b286c18430efe4bac36662127d4851bd9d40d77238fd71a7c194d9b4`.
Fixture SHA-256: `c02c08a179a4662bfec0dfd4f51a6c1674fb86f958c828223b1f2af746c65996`.
The generator source is not distributed, so this fixture cannot be regenerated
from a clean checkout. The hashes identify the recorded generator and output;
they do not establish current-checkout Lean/native correspondence.

## Edwards map vectors

`edwards-map.json` contains input/output pairs from Monero
`4f92268d7c16741cfb41e5bbe2aa46cc260a9ea5`'s
`ge_fromfe_frombytes_vartime`, followed by `ge_mul8` and compression.
The 137 inputs cover zero, one, field boundaries, the high input bit and
SHA-256 digests of decimal indices 0..127. The [independent producer](../../../../common/tests/reference/monero/README.md)
regenerates them without calling zkc.
